notes.title: Update of the Autumn
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/2dc0b7beea57205535864fe999231959e7cf4e27.png

Hi all!

Thanks for tuning in to another Margin of the Strange Information update (and the first one we've posted on Steam)! You may be curious on what the team has been up to in the past few busy, busy months. Fret not, we have some cool things to show!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/179d341f2aaabed81486dbfea0cf9e610b007b82.gif

First, if you've supported us on Kickstarter, we detailed an update on fulfillment + showed a preview of our physical merch rewards that we're getting ready to produce! You can check that out here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/d957f7601ef42836bfef7a73bc3e655524d04ed1.png

As for our current work on the game, the team has been continuing to build out the game's world and construct the playable part of the main narrative. Most of our attention recently has been focused on our very first demo, which unlocks for certain kickstarter backers sometime in the next few months. But even if you don’t have access to the demo, here’s some sneak peeks for everyone!

This is the Umbrella biome revealed a while back, now with some more structures added
[previewyoutube=Km7STSUdovw;full][/previewyoutube]

These large patches of crystals emit a Strange energy that seems to affect nearby plant life, but maybe that could work in your favor...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/d4e532c29e2e5d415d53d5a8f13ddd424c179059.jpg

Here's a preview of another biome that some of you can visit soon in the demo! We didn't want to give away too much, so here's just a look inside one of the buildings for the time being. All plant life in this biome grow out of pools of water like this one:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/cd3299ba75583bd58beab3043a822f8d0b4a3099.png
 
Here's an example of the doors you can use to access different biomes from your home garden. It took a while for us to nail down the look, but we’re pretty happy with the result.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/ae3736c5a72843e2239dde06b981a43d8208f0d5.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/f5b7a43dce71f38d4b34af2768adb7211c3012fd.gif

Of course, this is just the presentable, polished in-game art. Most of our other work was designing and further refining our various gameplay loops and systems, which probably isn’t very exciting to anyone who doesn’t like flowcharts…But we like flowcharts so we’re showing them anyway! (Spoilers have been redacted for your viewing pleasure)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/31acd2585381f7d076d9bbecdea0f5d4120ad955.png

And, what the heck, have a few embarrassingly rough drafts for Ling's animations too while we're at it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024414/c3b2eb5622bcd9445dcb3ade4b7d340f6d3b29bd.png

...and that's all we have to share for now! 

When you hear from us again, we'll have fulfillment for the merch items locked in for Kickstarter backers, as well as provide more details about the upcoming demo that is exclusive to beta players. If you have any questions, you're always free to reach out on our Discord. 

Have a good autumn, and see you soon!
- Future Cat Games
